summary_md: **Ian Pascoe ([@ianpascoe_](https://x.com/ianpascoe_/status/2116117998024978590))** released skills to avoid 'grilling fatigue' from interview-style design skills: **grill-yourself** has the agent answer its own design questions and escalate only when needed, and **grill-subagent** spawns an interviewee subagent; both report the full design tree afterward ([ian-pascoe/skills](https://github.com/ian-pascoe/skills)).
relevance: Reduces human load in design-interview agent workflows.
